audit_metadata.project: ManuMind AI — Explainable Multi-Agent AI System for Manufacturing Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis

database_subsystem.session_lifecycle: SessionLocal generator pattern (get_db) with guaranteed cleanup

failure_risk_regression.reason: Phase 2 Step 5 NO-GO constraint due to synthetic coverage limitations; no model artifact exists
failure_risk_regression.action_required: Expose Tool 3 as formal unsupported capability stub returning NOT_AVAILABLE

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Retrieve metadata, criticality, and recent 5-channel telemetry for specific machine assets

output_schema.readings: array of sensor readings [vibration, temperature, pressure, current, rpm, timestamp]

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Machine ID regex validation, maximum row limit (500), read-only transaction

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Run real-time tabular or sequence anomaly detection with optional SHAP/attribution explainability

input_schema.readings: array/object conforming to SensorReadingInput or SequenceWindowInput

output_schema.explanation: optional object (SHAP values or feature MSE attribution)

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Canonical feature order enforcement, non-finite float rejection, strict 30-step window length

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Query machine multi-step failure probability or remaining useful life (FORMAL STUB)
seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.underlying_source: Formal unsupported capability stub honoring Phase 2 Step 5 NO-GO constraint

output_schema.message: Failure risk regression was formally decommissioned in Phase 2 Step 5 due to synthetic coverage limits
output_schema.alternative_recommendation: Use detect_anomaly for current equipment condition assessment

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Zero uncalibrated risk fabrication, explicit documentation of baseline invariant

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Query past maintenance incidents, technician actions, and outcomes for machine assets

output_schema.records: array of objects (id, machine_id, date, issue, action, outcome)

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Machine ID validation, bounded pagination, read-only session

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Perform dense semantic vector search across 418 technical SOPs and historical incidents with citations

output_schema.results: array of ranked evidence segments with source citations and similarity scores
output_schema.grounded_response: optional GroundedAnswer object with safety validation metadata

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Pre-retrieval safety gates (prompt injection, safety interlock circumvention, operational commands)

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Classify optical workpiece surface defects using ResNet-18 vision classifier
seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Path traversal defense (resolved path must reside in DEFECT_IMAGES_DIR), 5MB buffer cap, PIL image verification

seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.functional_scope: Create formal maintenance work order linked to an alert with mandatory human authorization
seven_tool_feasibility_matrix.security_boundaries: Service-layer enforcement: raises TicketApprovalError if approved_by is missing/blank. No autonomous self-approval.

validation_rules: approved_by must not be None or whitespace-only
alert_id must correspond to existing Alert record
idempotent: returns existing Ticket if already created for alert
updates alert.status to APPROVED atomically upon ticket creation
ticket_approval_security_assessment.bypass_prevention: MCP tool parameter approved_by will be required with no default value; tool documentation explicitly prohibits autonomous agent sign-off

concurrency_and_transport_assessment.transport_rationale: Standard for local IDE and multi-agent harness integrations; eliminates network exposure and port management
concurrency_and_transport_assessment.chromadb_concurrency: PersistentClient SQLite read concurrency supported; pre-warmed singleton instance prevents contention
concurrency_and_transport_assessment.database_concurrency: Scoped SessionLocal per MCP request prevents cross-request session leakage

conditions_for_phase4.title: MCP SDK Installation in Dedicated/Managed Environment
conditions_for_phase4.description: Install mcp Python SDK in Phase 4 Step 1 under a dedicated requirements specification without mutating the frozen RAG lockfile.

conditions_for_phase4.title: Environment Dual-Stack Execution Strategy
conditions_for_phase4.description: Establish a process bridge or reconciled virtual environment to allow tools to communicate across ML (TensorFlow/SHAP) and RAG (ChromaDB/PyTorch).

conditions_for_phase4.title: Human-in-the-Loop Ticket Approval Gate Enforcement
conditions_for_phase4.description: Tool 7 (create_ticket) must make approved_by strictly mandatory with zero autonomous bypass or default values.

conditions_for_phase4.title: Failure Risk NO-GO Invariant Preservation
conditions_for_phase4.description: Tool 3 (predict_failure_risk) must return NOT_AVAILABLE and document the Phase 2 Step 5 constraint; no risk scores may be fabricated.
